snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 - Supernova - Dev Diary, pt. 7: The Making of the Bloodstar (Reprise)
snippet.description:
For those of you who always wondered how a space ship is made in a high-end 3D sci-fi action shooter, here's a little video that illustrates the different steps in the making of the Bloodstar, the most powerful ship in Fishlabs Entertainments upcoming outer space adventure Galaxy on Fire 2 - Supernova (scheduled to be released on iPad, iPhone, iPod touch and Mac on August 31st, 2012). 

To stay up to date about the development of the new GOF2 add-on, check out our bi-weekly developer diaries at http://www.fishlabs.net/en/blog/. We're looking forward to meet you there and read your comments!
